rows.text: # Attention consolidation: scheduler and source inspection

2026-09-12. Primary-agent adversarial review under autonomous authorization.
Accepted lifecycle B is unchanged. No public source, record, owner, model or number
is introduced by this review. General ATTN-001 remains OPEN.
## Executed substrate findings

The actual DeterministicScheduler supports the required atomic composition without
changing phase ordering. A fixture adapter preflights a base proposal and a separate
consolidation receipt against B0 and declared batch inputs. Each member returns B0;
only finish publishes the combined state. Both members remain terminal. Reversing
their execution order leaves final content and history equal. This is composition,
not permission for a handler to read an uncommitted sibling write.

Six new CB-A..F tests execute that scheduler: base durable before later consolidation;
base durable without any outcome; same-instant order independence with B0-only member
visibility; rejection of an unencoded target; whole-instant rollback on late combined
failure; and preservation of a previously committed base when later consolidation
fails. Four existing AMB scheduler tests also pass, including rejection of a chained
phase140 writer. The first ten-test report is preserved separately.

These fixtures use explicit test strings and simple content, not production IDs or
admission. They prove scheduler expressibility, not authenticated source binding,
PRJ/IDN, public memory reads, a lawful psychological effect or whole-prefix restore.
EL-B1..12 therefore remain public proof obligations, NOT PASSED by these fixtures.
## Accepted sources do not yet supply an event effect

| Inspected source | What it supplies | What it does not supply |
|---|---|---|
| measurement-evidence-carriage/0.1-candidate | Authenticated embedded203, exact diagnostic level and safe unit context | Effect of an event; body fuel semantics; causal attribution; general payload lookup |
| embodied-level-observation/0.1-candidate | A permitted current reserve bin, or unavailable source metadata | Consequence-lane sensing or exact hidden level |
| embodied-pressure/0.1-candidate | Deficit pressure from the admitted bin's upper bound and safe threshold | Applied replenishment, event efficacy, future pressure or a general stored Need |
| embodied-replenishment/0.1-candidate | Truth-side before/potential/applied/overflow/after | Character evidence or a character-readable causal link |
| SEM-001G causal-role evidence | Observer-relative analytical roles from permitted bindings | Arbitrary event-to-event causality, action-effect magnitude or permission to traverse trace ancestry |
| character-learning-evidence/0.5-candidate | Consequence227 →269 →270 with exact immediate-source carriage | Numeric interpretation, appraisal, causal attribution, belief reads or effect resolution |

Source locations: src/campaign3/embodiedMath.ts, embodiedRuntime.ts and
embodiedReplenishment.ts; docs/formal/EMBODIED_RESERVE_SHAPE_ACCEPTANCE.md;
docs/formal/MEASUREMENT_EVIDENCE_CARRIAGE.md; docs/formal/EVENT_SEMANTIC_BINDING.md
§SEM-001G; docs/planning/EVID_001_DRAFT_RESOLUTION.md. Historical “not implemented”
sentences in accepted shape receipts are not current qualification dispositions.

The public EMB source presently senses at10 and applies replenishment at110. Its
accepted scope explicitly excludes consequence sensing. Moving that sampler to120
or handing replenishment output479 to cognition would broaden the source contract.
Neither is an adapter convenience under the current frozen model.
## Concrete non-identifiability witness

The new OI-A..C tests invoke actual accepted EMB math, not a replacement formula.
Capacity100, bin width10, pressure threshold60, with no elapsed depletion:

| Hidden realization | Before | Delivered/applied | After | Perceived before/after bins | Derived before/after pressure |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| A | 20 | 10 | 30 | 20..30 then30..40 | 1/2 then1/3 |
| B | 29 | 1 | 30 | 20..30 then30..40 | 1/2 then1/3 |

The observed operands are identical while applied effect differs tenfold. This is
a mathematical component counterexample to recovering exact realized effect from
these operands, even if a future authorized consequence sampler supplies the second
bin. It is not an executed public two-sample profile.

OI-B holds perceived bins and applied effect equal while changing potential/overflow
at capacity. OI-C holds both bins and zero pressure equal while applied effect is0
versus5. Thus neither pressure relief nor absence of pressure is an alias for realized
effect. A hidden-truth-derived field would split OI-A illegally at the character boundary.

Even an admitted net level change would not independently establish that a particular
event caused it. Common subject, temporal order, source IDs, tracking continuity and
shared delivery ancestry provide no such cognitive claim by themselves. The current
source packet also lacks a prior estimate whose meaning is this event's effect;
the existing diagnostic-level prediction cannot be relabeled as that estimate.
## Review disposition

[Combined report](ATTENTION_CONSOLIDATION_SOURCE_TESTS_REV1.json):13 tests pass,
comprising six new lifecycle fixtures, three actual-math source counterexamples and
four retained barrier tests. [Earlier report](ATTENTION_CONSOLIDATION_BARRIER_TESTS_REV1.json)
retains the preceding ten-test run. No new production source changed.

The arithmetic counterexamples prove insufficient information, not the right
psychological response. That remaining distinction is made concrete in the
[consolidation credit decision](GENERAL_ATTENTION_CONSOLIDATION_CREDIT_DECISION.md).
Existing32 draft recipes and work bounds exclude the new source/lifecycle and must
not be promoted as if these tests supplied its public proof.

A further declaration debt is explicit: initial acquisition must enter the
architecture's registered character-learning boundary through a newly specified
selected-encoding evidence basis. An empty or correct route tag alone is insufficient.
This can be designed under lifecycle B without changing consequence-only269/270 or
pretending a current experience is a consequence. EVID's explicit allowance for
other future learning-evidence paths is preserved; no generic union is widened here.
# General attention: what gives an earlier episode consolidation credit?

2026-09-12. **OPEN architectural decision.** Lifecycle B remains accepted.
No accepted initial-encoding bytes, EVID contract or qualified model is reopened.
## Decision in one example

The character encodes a lamp, then experiences bodily relief. The lamp was visible,
but no interaction connecting it to the relief was perceived and no admitted prior
causal knowledge connects them.

May temporal co-occurrence alone produce the first **outcome-linked consolidation**
of that lamp episode, or must an explicit fallible event-to-outcome attribution first
provide the credit assignment? These predict different memory histories for the
same permitted observations. This is a choice of cognitive mechanism and prerequisite
topology, not an identity, scheduler or calibration decision.
## Recommended first contract: attribution-gated consolidation

Require a separately traceable, character-side attribution assessment before an
event receives outcome-dependent credit. It may be wrong about objective causation;
it must expose its permitted evidence and rule. Temporal proximity or common subject
alone is insufficient in the first profile. A lack of support yields unavailable
credit, not zero realized effect and not an invented causal target.
Proposed causal path, pending this ruling and subsequent exact seam review:

admitted consequence evidence + permitted prior/interaction evidence
      → fallible outcome attribution and evidence-valued effect assessment
      → consolidation assessment targeting an already encoded episode
      → append-only consolidation under its registered owner

The conservative EVID269/270 path remains intact beneath this assessment. Initial
encoding proceeds without waiting. No character transition reads replenishment
truth, source dispatch ancestry or an omniscient effect ledger. The new assessment
does not backdate a Cause role into the original SEM envelope. A valid target must
use the existing retained selection address and accepted subject projection.

This choice best preserves MEC-007's requirement that outcome-dependent relevance
apply to causally connected material, while replacing the historical truth-side
EffectProvenance shortcut with a separate fallible character process. It expands
the work to include a minimal causal-attribution source/assessment and appropriate
positive, false-attribution and insufficient-evidence controls before consolidation
can earn a positive qualification. It does not require a general causal graph or
final Need ontology merely to begin that investigation.
## Alternative: experiential association without causal credit

The first contract could instead allow noticed pressure change to modulate an
explicitly bounded set of recently encoded episodes through temporal association.
The output would mean “encoded around this experienced change,” never “caused it.”
The lamp can then gain consolidation history without a supported causal relation.

This is a legitimate distinct hypothesis, but it needs an explicit temporal
eligibility law and must keep pressure change distinct from realized regulatory
effect. It cannot discharge the historical causal-relevance control by renaming
association as attribution. That control and the later attribution seam remain open.
Choosing this alternative does not authorize closing General Attention early.
## Why the existing ruling does not select this

Accepted B separates acquisition from later consolidation and forbids rewriting or
resurrection. It expressly leaves the later mechanism to be qualified. It does not
say whether temporal association is sufficient credit or causal interpretation is a
prerequisite. The Architecture distinguishes association, expectation and causal
learning; those separate boxes should not be collapsed through an implementation
default. SEM-001G currently excludes arbitrary event-to-event causality.

The [source inspection and executed counterexamples](ATTENTION_CONSOLIDATION_SOURCE_REVIEW_REV1.md)
also show why exact hidden Applied cannot simply fill the gap. Equal safe body bins
and pressures can conceal Applied10 versus1. A pressure difference, a net level
change and an event-attributed effect have different meanings. No choice grants a
truth oracle or promotes a speculative effect law.
## Prepared proof obligations and limits

Under the recommended contract, freeze these additional obligations for the later
whole seam: unsupported temporal neighbour gets no causal credit; supported false
attribution remains possible under hidden-truth intervention; equal safe operands
yield equal assessments; foreign subject/observer and unencoded targets reject;
unavailable support differs from known zero; original episode bytes remain exact;
and an attribution-removal intervention isolates the downstream consolidation effect.
These are NOT PASSED and do not specify a new numeric law.

The scheduler side no longer needs a decision: six new actual-scheduler fixtures
support immediate base formation and separate atomic consolidation. Thirteen combined
tests pass. Production source contracts, field inventories, allocations, source
authenticity, restore, model packaging and corpus qualification remain pending.

**Requested ruling:** proceed first with attribution-gated consolidation (recommended),
or first with explicitly noncausal experiential association while retaining the
causal-credit obligation for a subsequent seam. No reapproval of lifecycle B is needed.
# Attribution-gated consolidation: accepted direction

2026-09-12. **Credit-assignment subdecision ACCEPTED.** This records the planning
analysis supplied by the user after the credit decision request. Lifecycle B is
unchanged. General ATTN-001 remains OPEN.
The first authorized outcome-linked consolidation path is attribution-gated:

experienced outcome + permitted episode/outcome connection evidence
      → separately traceable observer-side attribution assessment
      → eligibility for outcome-dependent consolidation credit

The [original decision request](GENERAL_ATTENTION_CONSOLIDATION_CREDIT_DECISION.md)
remains historical. This receipt resolves its open choice, not the exact source,
assessment law, record shapes, numeric effect, persistent update or model packaging.
## Frozen architectural constraints

The assessment must be explicit and inspectable. Conscious propositional belief,
natural-language reasoning, a general causal graph and a stored causal belief are
not prerequisites imposed by this ruling. OutcomeAttributionAssessment is a useful
provisional name, not an allocated schema or new belief family.

Attribution may be uncertain or objectively wrong. Its actual operands must be
permitted character evidence. Temporal proximity, common subject and hidden
authoritative effect provenance are insufficient by themselves. The character's
conclusion must remain invariant under changes in hidden causal truth that preserve
all admitted operands. Runtime admission can authenticate an evidence producer;
that authentication does not establish the truth of the resulting attribution.

Supported attribution makes this path eligible. Insufficient evidence or no observed
outcome makes credit unavailable. Neither means effect=0, known absence of causation,
nor supported contrary attribution. Contrary-attribution response and uncertainty
calibration require their own exact semantics; no numeric confidence is implied here.

Eligibility is not an effect measurement and does not by itself authorize a state
write. A subsequent consolidation assessment must have independently justified
operands and a qualified law. The existing observer-safe-bin counterexamples remain
binding: attribution cannot recover hidden Applied, Potential or Overflow.

Attribution and any later correction append cognitive history. They do not rewrite
the original episode, initial encoding factors or previous assessment, and do not
backdate a Cause role into the initial SEM envelope. The target must already be
encoded, or be a valid base in the explicitly declared atomic formation composition
under lifecycle B. The same-instant composition must not resurrect excluded content.
## Temporal association remains a future candidate

Experiential association may later coexist with causal-credit consolidation. It is
not rejected, merged, retired or qualified by this ruling. A later association seam
may assert co-occurrence/contextual association under bounded eligibility; it may
not silently populate Cause, event-to-outcome attribution or Need relevance because
an event produced an outcome. Its possible effects on accessibility, valence or
anticipation remain hypotheses, not authorized persistent writes.

MEC-007/CTL-004 retain the causal-relevance control; MEC-008/009/010 retain distinct
association/access/reinforcement controls. No historical mechanism is silently lost.
The minimal EVID269/270 contract, SEM causal-role domain and character evidence
reference union remain unchanged. New assessment admission requires a new exact
seam rather than an indirect truth handle or generic payload resolver.
## Accepted proof obligations — frozen, not passed

1. A merely recent episode with no admitted connection evidence gets no causal credit.
2. Supported false attribution is possible: hidden truth does not veto it.
3. Equal permitted operands produce equal assessment at matched output identities.
4. Foreign observer, foreign subject and unencoded target admission reject.
5. Insufficient support and an unobserved outcome yield unavailable credit, not zero
   effect or a claim of no connection.
6. Original episode bytes and earlier attribution records remain immutable.
7. Removing attribution support isolates the downstream consolidation effect while
   holding episode, outcome, timing and bodily evidence fixed.

The13 earlier component/fixture tests remain evidence for scheduler expressibility
and source limitations only. They do not pass these public attribution obligations.
Proceed with source and symbolic design under the standing autonomous authorization;
no reapproval of this decision is needed.
# General attention encoding lifecycle: accepted B

2026-09-12. **Architectural direction accepted: B.** Records the planning review
supplied by the user, selecting immediate durable encoding followed by separate
outcome-linked consolidation. General ATTN-001 remains OPEN.

This resolves the choice in [the historical decision request](GENERAL_ATTENTION_OUTCOME_ENCODING_DECISION.md).
That proposal, including its recommendation of A, remains unchanged as history.
This receipt supersedes its open disposition and recommendation, not its substrate
findings. No numeric allocation, complete seam acceptance or runtime qualification
is implied.
## Accepted boundary

Initial encoding records acquisition-time cognition. Only evidence and admissible
prior information available then may determine its historical factors. Durable
formation does not wait for an expected future consequence. Here “immediate” means
the acquisition transaction's normal durable commit, not a new persistent write at
phase40 or visibility to other handlers before quiescence.

Later observer-safe experience may produce a separate append-only consolidation
operation over an encoded episode. It cannot rewrite selected evidence, initial
factors, encoding assessment or what the observer knew at acquisition. It is not a
second episode and must not count as another presentation of the original unless a
separately accepted law explicitly defines such a presentation.

Outcome-dependent historical Need relevance is a **candidate consolidation law**.
It is not automatically accepted mathematics and cannot be supplied by TaskConcern.
Perceptual surprise and consequence surprise are separate time-local assessments;
each needs its own admissible evidence and prior. Neither hidden outcome truth nor
later causal interpretation can become an earlier encoding factor.

Consolidation cannot create an original episode that was not encoded. A later
observable outcome can itself be encoded under its own acquisition contract.
Reconstructing an earlier event from that outcome remains a separate future seam.

Keep immutable episode content, append-only consolidation provenance, current
derived/materialized memory state, and contextual accessibility distinguishable.
The ruling chooses this lifecycle, not a scalar shared by importance, retention,
recognition and accessibility. No particular strengthening, association,
fragmentation or reorganization formula has been accepted here.
## Same-instant implementation constraint

Logical order remains acquisition assessment, safe consequence assessment, base
episode formation, then outcome-linked consolidation, even within one instant.
The actual scheduler's phase140 batch members are terminal. Therefore this ruling
does not authorize a formation handler to enqueue another phase140 handler.

The successor must explicitly reconcile a new base and its consolidation within one
atomic barrier while preserving separate derivations and mutation authorities.
Uncommitted sibling writes are not ordinary owner-readable state. A proposed base
may only be used through a declared, validated batch composition rule; existing
common-B0 declarations alone do not supply that rule. Failure must publish neither
the base nor consolidation, and restore must reproduce their separate provenance.

For a consequence in a later instant, the original must already be durable and
recallable under the accepted retrieval rules. Lack of a later consequence must not
cancel, delay or erase that original encoding.

Reuse the draft's SelectionOccurrenceId episode address. The review's illustrative
episode/consolidation numbers are not a request for a duplicate EpisodeId, occurrence
namespace or allocator. Consolidation occurrence identity, exact source references
and storage declarations require separate symbolic inventory before allocation.
## Adversarial review and next work

Architecture §8 and North Star §11 support the separation of memory content,
retention, accessibility and later consolidation. Architecture's learning boundary
still requires CharacterLearningEvidence and registered family mutation authority;
this ruling does not add appraisal fields to the accepted minimal OutcomeEvaluation.
The existing consequence SemanticExperience → OutcomeEvaluation →
CharacterLearningEvidence route must remain intact.

The current32 draft recipes disable Need and surprise. They remain valid bounded
comparison proposals but cannot qualify the new consolidation path or close General
Attention. Existing139-event/172-output/152-slot bounds exclude this new path and
must not be reused as its total-work proof.

Next design work is an observer-safe consequence/target association and assessment
contract, followed by exact lifecycle carriers, owner reads, batch composition and
competing consolidation laws. Same observer, qualified CharacterId and chronological
order are necessary but insufficient evidence that a consequence concerns a
particular episode. A truth event ID, proximity, matching glyph or shared subject
must not silently provide that association. Ambiguous or absent evidence must stay
unavailable; it cannot become zero effect or an invented target.

MEC-007/CTL-004 preserve the historical salience mechanism as a control, with its
outcome-dependent part investigated downstream. MEC-008/009/010 still require
distinct association, access, decay and reinforcement comparisons. RET-003/006/010
continue to prohibit clipped censored surprise, truth Overflow salience and
commitment-as-Need. This lifecycle decision retires none of those obligations.
## Frozen proof obligations — not passed

| Vector | Required distinction |
|---|---|
| EL-B1 | Recall before a later consequence can use the already committed original. |
| EL-B2 | No consequence ever arrives: original encoding still commits normally. |
| EL-B3 | Equal acquisition evidence and different later outcomes preserve identical initial episode bytes and factors. |
| EL-B4 | An excluded or zero-retained original cannot be resurrected by consolidation. |
| EL-B5 | A consolidation adds no duplicate original episode or implicit presentation. |
| EL-B6 | Missing, ambiguous, foreign-observer or foreign-subject target evidence cannot consolidate an episode. |
| EL-B7 | Same-instant formation/consolidation preserves separate causal records and one atomic commit; no terminal child emission. |
| EL-B8 | Failure in either same-instant operation rolls back all roots, queue and allocators. |
| EL-B9 | Whole-prefix restore reproduces initial bytes, consolidation history and subsequent access. |
| EL-B10 | Perceptual and consequence surprise use their respective evidence times; later evidence cannot revise the earlier assessment. |
| EL-B11 | Hidden truth changes with identical admitted evidence cannot alter character-side consolidation. |
| EL-B12 | No-consolidation control preserves initial encoding and isolates the qualified later effect. |

Exact lawful effects, observer-safe effect measurement/connection sources, category
and Cause/Incidental sources, public wrappers, finite model recipes, numeric gates
and corpus membership remain unfinished. These are design/proof work, not another
request for the already resolved A/B choice.
# General attention: outcome-dependent encoding lifecycle decision

2026-09-12. **OPEN architectural decision.** General ATTN-001 remains OPEN.
No accepted seam, numeric allocation or production implementation changes here.
## Why the current recipes cannot close General Attention

The32 draft recipes keep Need and surprise Disabled and use a homogeneous category
prior. They can test selected encoding, association/access and delayed TaskConcern
feedback, but cannot satisfy all MEC-007/EXP-007 obligations merely by being implemented.
Category evidence and positive Cause/Incidental also remain source debts.

Read-only inspection of reference/src/model/salience.ts confirms that historical Need
relevance uses urgency times the magnitude of a realized regulatory effect, only for
concepts causally connected to that outcome. Surprise compares a prior estimate with
permitted point/lower-bound/upper-bound evidence. Correct censored-evidence handling is
mandatory; raw clipped discrepancy and truth Overflow remain prohibited shortcuts.
Historical EffectProvenance cannot be imported as observer-safe causal evidence.

The current profile supplies an earlier diagnostic measurement and present three-port
scenes. It supplies neither this event's experienced regulatory effect nor observer-safe
unit/effect connection evidence. TaskConcern cannot be renamed Need relevance or
surprise. Doing so would violate both the retained non-Need distinction and the
requirement to consume actual permitted evidence.
## The concrete lifecycle choice

The draft selects and evaluates encoding at40, retains at130 and forms immutable
episodes in the140 sibling batch. Accepted EVENT_ORDERING places consequence experience
freeze at124 and outcome evaluation/learning evidence at130. A current event's observed
outcome therefore cannot already have determined encoding at40.

For events perceived before their consequence, decide whether that consequence
determines the first durable encoding or produces a later consolidation record. This
changes admitted carriers, episode lifecycle, trace ancestry and batch target handling.
It is not a calibration choice. The public memory shape should not be allocated while
silently leaving this requirement outside its intended lifecycle.
### A — Defer durable encoding for consequence-bearing episodes (recommended)

Keep selected evidence provisional. A separately accepted observer-safe salience
assessment consumes the actual consequence, admissible prior and explicit unit/effect
connection evidence. Compute final encoding afterward, then produce one retained
encoding and one formation triple at140. Current-only scenes retain their explicit
outcome-independent path.

This preserves immutable historical factors and one formation per target. It provides
no durable episode for that event before its expected consequence. Missing/unavailable
consequences need an explicit completion rule, not invented zero or abandoned work.
A first bounded profile could restrict the outcome to the same instant; across-instant
deferral would need a new pending carrier/save rule.

The new assessment is separate from accepted EVID OutcomeEvaluation, whose conservative
fields do not silently acquire appraisal, utility, causal attribution or surprise.
### B — Encode immediately, then append outcome-linked consolidation

Keep initial encoding independent of the outcome. Later observer-safe assessment
produces a new append-only record linked to the episode. Original bytes remain intact.
Retrieval must explicitly define how initial encoding and later consolidation affect
current accessibility and associations.

This permits recall before the consequence and preserves an inspectable evolution,
but requires a new consolidation record/lifecycle and association-update rule. If both
stages occur in one instant, the barrier must reconcile their target rather than run
two independent writes to the same character leaf. Later salience cannot be relabelled
as the original episode's historical encoding strength.

Neither option authorizes stronger outcome truth, raw-observation learning, TaskConcern
as a Need, new EVID semantics or an unreviewed belief read/write order. Both need a new
observer-safe effect/connection/assessment seam. After the lifecycle choice, that seam
and the remaining category/causal-role sources can be designed and reviewed autonomously.
The options make different memory predictions; the authorities do not select between
them for this new public contract.
## Progress preserved

An exact EAM search found a strict retrieval-order reversal with identical prior
histories. Three early Actor/Actor/Actor encodings retain{a,b,c}; the fourth
Actor/Actor/Participant encoding retains{a,d,e}. Cue a gives quantized activation
[101/100,2/25,2/25,3/100,1/50]. After matched hypothetical presentations at6 and7,
baseline pull weight1 ranks episode5 above4 at8 by1/75; weight7/5 ranks4 above5 by1/750.
Both select the same two episodes: this witnesses ordering, not winner-set change.

Four component tests pass, including graph expansion only when nodes first encode.
Four retained actual scheduler barrier fixtures also pass. The current report is
[revision2](ATTENTION_RETRIEVAL_AND_BARRIER_TESTS_REV2.json); revision1 retains the
earlier seven-test run. The exploratory search is separately retained in
ATTENTION_RETRIEVAL_WITNESS_SEARCH_REV1.json. None qualifies public acquisition,
state writers, source authenticity or whole-memory behavior.
## Decision requested

# Same-barrier acquisition and complete retention loss

2026-09-12. **ARCHITECTURAL DECISION REQUIRED.** Recency component testing is complete
at its stated scope. This is an acquisition-history/settlement question, not priority.
## Concrete trigger

A current selection produces nonempty eligible encoding. In that same instant its
kind has zero retention capacity, or other same-time candidates consume all capacity
under the canonical tie rule. The accepted policy removes every unit of this proposed
acquisition. The run must succeed: cognitive scarcity is not invalid workload.

Previously retained acquisitions are unambiguous: their historical occurrence remains,
and final-child loss removes their current recall target. The unresolved case is
**new formation and final-child loss within its first atomic commit**.

The [identity ruling](GENERAL_ATTENTION_ACQUISITION_IDENTITY_RESOLUTION.md) defines an
acquisition as successful creation of durable ordinary memory and forbids phantom
successful acquisitions on failed settlement. The [recency ruling](GENERAL_ATTENTION_RETENTION_PRIORITY_RESOLUTION.md)
requires the complete barrier set and zero-capacity loss. Neither explicitly specifies
whether logical formation followed by loss inside a successful instant counts as
durable creation when no current content survives that instant.

The draft phase130 evidence output already carries a candidate acquisition identity.
The generic scheduler commits successful outputs atomically; merely omitting the
state append does not erase that identity-bearing output. Consequently this choice
changes carrier/output admission, not just a conditional in the final memory writer.
## Alternatives

**A — committed formation followed by committed loss (recommended for causal legibility).**
A valid nonempty formation and its retention loss are distinct logical transitions
within one successful atomic commit. Historical acquisition exists, followed by a
loss disposition; current surviving content can be empty immediately. No failed
instant commits either record. This explicitly interprets successful creation as a
committed formation event, not a promise that content survives to the next quiescent
read. It preserves selection → acquisition → loss distinctions at capacity zero and
the proposed single acquisition occurrence across evidence and history.

A requires explicit acceptance of that same-instant interpretation of durability.
Historical evidence is not a character resolver. It must not be counted as an ordinary
recallable target, automatic presentation, retention success or persistent payload
when its last unit is gone. Same-instant attribution cannot read removed content
through this historical acquisition merely because a formation existed; any permitted
transient evidence use needs its own explicit admission and ordering.

**B — survival-gated acquisition commitment.** A new proposal whose entire content
loses at its first barrier commits no AcquisitionOccurrenceId. Selection/encoding
diagnostics remain, and the loss/denial is modeled rather than a run error. At least
one surviving unit is necessary for a new durable acquisition; already historical
acquisitions can later lose their last unit normally.

B preserves a stricter quiescent meaning of durable creation, but requires revising
the draft phase130 acquisition-bearing output. Such output cannot become authoritative
for a proposal that never qualifies. The final contract must move or condition fresh
acquisition allocation/output production through the existing scheduler and learning
boundary, without a redundant formation identity, identifier reuse or selective
rollback of an otherwise successful instant.
## Discrimination and invariant surface

Both options yield no current recall target for a fresh proposal at capacity zero.
They differ in authoritative historical acquisition existence, source idempotency
bookkeeping, occurrence/output budgets and the meaning of same-instant formation.
This must not be resolved by whichever adapter is easier to implement.

Both preserve original acquisition time, exact initial evidence history as appropriate
to the chosen disposition, no retrieval refresh, intact groups, per-kind partitions,
single-authority reconciliation and total rollback on actual failure. Neither creates
character access to pruned payloads or qualifies acquired importance.

Recommend A with explicit formation/loss dispositions and empty-current-state semantics;
it makes the newly accepted cognitive loss visible as loss rather than collapsing it
into never-acquired history. B is also coherent and is not rejected by this packet.
No public formation implementation or numeric allocation proceeds until resolved.
# Same-barrier formation then loss: A accepted

2026-09-12. **ACQUISITION/RETENTION COMPOSITION RULING ACCEPTED by supplied review.**
Resolves the [decision packet](GENERAL_ATTENTION_SAME_BARRIER_ACQUISITION_DECISION.md).
No whole public shape, numeric allocation, persistence or runtime verdict is implied.
## Meaning of successful acquisition

AcquisitionOccurrenceId means selected content successfully crossed the governed
ordinary-memory formation boundary. It does not guarantee survival through that
instant's retention reconciliation. Here durable means entry into the ordinary-memory
lifecycle, not guaranteed availability at the next quiescent read. This explicitly
refines the earlier identity-B wording without equating selection and acquisition.

A valid nonempty formation followed by complete same-instant loss commits both logical
dispositions atomically. Historical acquisition exists; an explicit complete-loss
disposition exists; current recallable content does not. The acquisition identity is
never reused. A failed instant commits neither disposition, and selection without
qualifying formation commits no acquisition.

Formation precedes retention logically even inside one atomic settlement. This does
not authorize handlers to expose provisional sibling state, emit terminal phase140
children, bypass PRJ/admission, or count historical formation as successful retention.
The complete-barrier policy and sole-authority reconciliation remain required.
## No access window or historical sample resolver

At quiescence, an acquisition with no surviving child is not an ordinary-memory target.
Retrieval cannot return it; attribution and consolidation cannot inspect vanished
child evidence; ordinary presentation cannot display it as remembered content.
History, source provenance and trace cannot resolve discarded samples.

Same-instant logical formation grants no implicit transient post-encoding access.
Ordinary-memory consumers use reconciled retained state at their authorized read point.
An earlier draft's same-instant positive-formation proposal must not be treated as
an unconditional read capability. Any future cognition using formed-but-not-yet-retained
content requires a separately reviewed transient-access seam.

Later consolidation therefore needs the appropriate surviving target, not simply
proof that it once formed. This ruling does not reopen attribution's evidence requirement
or let supported attribution resurrect a lost operand.
## Minimum governed history

The eventual bounded disposition may record acquisition identity, source selection,
original acquisition time, kind and complete-loss status. These are semantic requirements,
not an allocated record layout. Forgotten evidence payloads must not be retained in
that governance record. No unbounded tombstone set or background evidence dictionary
is authorized. Richer diagnostic/test traces are bounded research instrumentation,
never character-side sample resolvers; their exact retention/persistence treatment
remains part of whole-profile closure.

Idempotency must distinguish a previously formed-and-lost acquisition from a source
that never formed. Identity non-reuse persists after complete loss. Current inventory
counts surviving acquisitions/units, not all historical formation occurrences.
Immediately lost acquisitions do not automatically create presentation history,
recollection, gameplay memory notifications or additional retention credit.
## Four required public branches — frozen, not passed

| Branch | Historical acquisition | Loss disposition | Current target |
|---|---|---|---|
| Positive formation with survivor | Yes | As applicable | Yes |
| Positive formation with first-barrier total loss | Yes | Explicit complete loss | No |
| No qualifying formation | No new acquisition | No acquisition loss fabricated | No new target |
| Actual settlement failure | No new committed acquisition | No new committed loss | Prior committed state preserved |

The last row preserves old state/history rather than erasing earlier acquisitions.
Tests must distinguish all four branches, including allocator/output/queue rollback,
source replay after total loss and prohibition on removed-content reads.

Compose the accepted recency and fragmentation components with phase130 candidate
evidence and phase140 formation/loss reconciliation. Declare payload-free loss history,
bounded replay metadata, surviving-state reads and auxiliary-family effects. The older
phase130 full-evidence draft is not proof that rich history can be retained indefinitely.
Recompute exact output/state/work bounds after the carrier and trace disposition close.

Existing16 recency/fragmentation tests and six recency source faults remain component
evidence only; they do not pass these public branches. Acquired-protection comparison
remains mandatory. General Attention stays OPEN; accepted historical models remain
unchanged.
